_notes: Neuro champions are mirrors, not Origin cores. `poles` is sparse: missing keys are 0. deficit keys are signed negative [-1,0]; mature/hyper are [0,1]. `purpose` is client-facing and must never name the four structures or any score.

champions.name: Warlord
champions.role: hold the floor by force and learn what force cannot hold
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a scarred warlord in dark plate with a broken standard planted in the arena floor
champions.purpose: The Warlord stands on the Coliseum floor to show what it costs to take a voice by force. He is here so the floor can be claimed another way.

champions.name: Archmage
champions.role: rule through knowing and risk never being known
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a tall archmage in star-embroidered robes, a lattice of runes hovering at their fingertips
champions.purpose: The Archmage claims the floor with knowledge held above everyone's head. She is here so knowing can come down to eye level and be spoken plainly.

champions.name: Dragon Sovereign
champions.role: own the sky and the hoard and the terms
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a crowned sovereign with dragon-scaled mantle and ember-lit eyes seated on a basalt throne at the arena's edge
champions.purpose: The Dragon Sovereign shows what a voice becomes when it must own everything to feel safe. He is here so the Crown of Verdict can be met without needing to hoard it.

champions.name: Beast Queen
champions.role: command by instinct and loyalty rather than law
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a queen in furs and bone-beads flanked by great loyal beasts, standing barefoot on the arena stone
champions.purpose: The Beast Queen holds the floor by instinct and by those who follow her. She is here to show a voice can be steady without being cruel.

champions.name: Death Knight
champions.role: keep fighting for a crown that no longer feels like anything
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a hollow-visored knight in blackened armor standing motionless, frost gathering on the arena floor around them
champions.purpose: The Death Knight kept fighting long after the fight stopped meaning anything. He is here so a voice can rest instead of grinding on empty.

champions.name: Trickster
champions.role: win the floor sideways and never be pinned to a claim
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a grinning trickster in mismatched motley juggling three small crowns, never quite standing still
champions.purpose: The Trickster takes the floor sideways so no one can pin him to a claim. He is here so a voice can be direct for once and still be safe.

champions.name: Paladin
champions.role: stand on the floor for something larger than winning
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a paladin in plain silver plate with a lowered shield, standing squarely under the Crown of Verdict
champions.purpose: The Paladin stands on the floor without shrinking and without crushing anyone. She is here to show what a claimed voice looks like when it is not at war.

champions.name: Living Construct
champions.role: do exactly what the law says and wonder if it has a will
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a towering stone-and-brass construct with a faint light behind its eye slits, standing at rigid attention
champions.purpose: The Living Construct does what it was built to do and is only beginning to wonder what it would choose. It is here so a voice can find out it has a will of its own.

champions.name: Exiled Heir
champions.role: want a voice and not take it by force
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a young heir in travel-worn finery standing at the arena gate, an empty seat waiting on the far side
champions.purpose: The Exiled Heir belongs on the floor and has never once stepped onto it. They are here so a voice can be claimed without being taken.

champions.name: Voidborn
champions.role: hold a floor by making everything else feel like nothing
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a figure of shifting shadow and cold starlight whose footsteps leave no print on the arena floor
champions.purpose: The Voidborn wins by making the room feel like nothing matters. They are here so a voice can be spoken into a floor that still holds weight.

champions.name: Sea King
champions.role: rule the whole harbor and refuse to see the dark current
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a broad sea king with a coral crown standing at the prow of the largest lashed vessel, back turned to the cold current
champions.purpose: The Sea King rules the harbor by looking only at the bright water. He is here so all three currents can be seen at once from the center platform.

champions.name: River Daughter
champions.role: carry the clear fast current and dread the cold one
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a young woman in flowing river-green with water running from her hair, standing where the clear current enters the harbor
champions.purpose: The River Daughter came in on the clear fast water and has never let herself touch the cold one. She is here so both can be true at the same time.

champions.name: Storm Giant
champions.role: be all one weather at a time
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a giant of cloud and grey muscle standing waist-deep where the currents meet, lightning in his beard
champions.purpose: The Storm Giant is only ever one weather at a time and the whole harbor feels it. He is here so two true things can share the same sky.

champions.name: Fox-faced Trickster
champions.role: tell each current a different story
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a slender fox-masked figure in patchwork silks perched on a mooring post, tail flicking over the water
champions.purpose: The Fox-faced Trickster tells each current a different story so none of them meet. They are here so one honest account can hold the whole harbor.

champions.name: Leviathan
champions.role: the thing under the dark cold current that everyone pretends is not there
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: an immense shadowed shape gliding beneath the dark cold current, one great eye passing under the lashed hulls
champions.purpose: The Leviathan is what everyone agreed not to look at under the cold water. It is here so what lives in the dark current can be seen without sinking the city.

champions.name: Coral Fish Men
champions.role: belong to all three currents and never leave the reef
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a small band of coral-scaled fish-folk clustered on the harbor pilings, living exactly where the three currents overlap
champions.purpose: The Coral Fish Men live right where the three currents overlap and they thrive there. They are here to show that mixed water is where things grow.

champions.name: Aged Pirate
champions.role: have sailed every current and made peace with the wrecks
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a weathered old pirate with a salt-white beard mending a net on the central platform, one wooden leg on the mosaic
champions.purpose: The Aged Pirate has sailed every current, wrecked on some, and sits mending nets on the center platform. He is here to show what accepting the whole voyage looks like.

champions.name: The Wonder
champions.role: see only the silver-bright current and call it the whole sea
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a luminous figure in silver-white robes standing in the bright current, arms open, eyes closed to the rest of the harbor
champions.purpose: The Wonder stands in the silver-bright water and calls it the whole sea. They are here so beauty can be kept without needing to erase the rest.

champions.name: Crab Men
champions.role: armor up and scuttle sideways from whatever is true
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a cluster of hunched crab-shelled folk edging sideways along the hull line, claws raised defensively
champions.purpose: The Crab Men move sideways from anything that stings and have grown thick shells doing it. They are here so the shell can be set down for one look at the whole water.

champions.name: Lava Rock Men
champions.role: cool hard around every hurt so nothing moves again
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: heavy figures of cooled black lava with faint red seams, standing utterly still on the harbor's edge
champions.purpose: The Lava Rock Men hardened around every old burn until nothing moves. They are here so what has cooled can soften enough to be felt.

champions.name: Young Sailor Boy
champions.role: first time seeing three currents and not yet needing to pick one
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a barefoot boy in a too-large sailor's coat leaning over the platform rail, watching all three currents with open curiosity
champions.purpose: The Young Sailor Boy sees three currents and does not yet need to pick one. He is here to show the whole harbor can be looked at with curiosity instead of alarm.

champions.name: The Sovereign
champions.role: keep every tower under one shadow
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a stern sovereign in storm-grey regalia on the highest cloudstone spire, every other tower casting the same shadow as hers
champions.purpose: The Sovereign keeps every tower under one shadow so none can drift. She is here so each spire can cast its own and the city still stand.

champions.name: Child of Echoes
champions.role: speak only in voices that were spoken first
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a small child of drifting cloud whose voice arrives a beat late and in someone else's tone
champions.purpose: The Child of Echoes only speaks in voices that were spoken first. They are here so one word can be said in a name that is their own.

champions.name: The Lover
champions.role: dissolve into whoever is nearest
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a radiant figure in rose-lit cloudsilk leaning fully into another spire until the two shapes blur
champions.purpose: The Lover leans so far into the nearest tower that the two blur into one. They are here so closeness can keep both shapes visible.

champions.name: The Warrior
champions.role: cut every tether and call it freedom
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: an armored warrior on a lone cloud island with severed lightning tethers hanging from its edges
champions.purpose: The Warrior cut every tether and calls the lonely island freedom. He is here so a bridge can stay standing without becoming a chain.

champions.name: The Healer
champions.role: carry everyone's weather and lose track of her own
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a gentle healer in pale robes moving between islands with her hands full of other people's small storms
champions.purpose: The Healer carries everyone's weather across the bridges and has lost track of her own. She is here so her own lamp can be kept lit too.

champions.name: The Jester
champions.role: be whatever the room needs so no one sees the real face
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a jester in ever-shifting cloud motley whose face changes to match whoever looks at it
champions.purpose: The Jester becomes whatever the room needs so the real face is never seen. They are here so one true face can be worn on the bridge.

champions.name: The Sage Wright
champions.role: build a tower that stands alone and stays connected
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: an old cloud-wright with a plumb line and chisel, shaping a spire that casts a shadow all its own while its bridge holds
champions.purpose: The Sage Wright builds towers that stand under their own shadow and keep their bridges. He is here to show what a lamp of one's own looks like among others.

champions.name: The Cloudsmith
champions.role: forge tethers so tight the islands cannot breathe
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a broad cloudsmith at a lightning forge hammering tethers tighter between two islands already touching
champions.purpose: The Cloudsmith forges the tethers tighter until the islands cannot breathe. They are here so a bond can be loosened without being lost.

champions.name: The Exile
champions.role: drift beyond the last tether and call the distance safety
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a solitary figure on a far cloud island beyond the last tether, watching the lit city from a distance
champions.purpose: The Exile drifted past the last tether and calls the distance safety. They are here so a 'no' can be said without it becoming a leaving.

champions.name: The Priestess
champions.role: hold the inherited fear as if it were law
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a veiled priestess in the oldest spire tending an altar of inherited fears passed down like relics
champions.purpose: The Priestess keeps the inherited fears lit on the altar as if they were law. She is here so what was handed down can be looked at and, if chosen, set down.

champions.name: The Rebel Daughter
champions.role: define herself only by what she is against
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a fierce young woman in torn cloudsilk standing on a tether with her back to the great spire, fists clenched
champions.purpose: The Rebel Daughter knows exactly what she is against and not yet who she is. She is here so her own name can be spoken and not only the refusal.

champions.name: The Mirrorborn
champions.role: reflect every face and have none
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a figure of polished cloud-glass reflecting every tower around it, with no shadow of its own
champions.purpose: The Mirrorborn reflects every tower and casts no shadow of its own. They are here so a first shape of their own can appear on the cloudstone.

champions.name: Hearth-Keeper
champions.role: keep the First Hearth lit for whoever returns
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a warm-eyed keeper in ember-colored wool tending the First Hearth, a second seat always pulled near the fire
champions.purpose: The Hearth-Keeper keeps the First Hearth lit and a second seat pulled near. She is here to show warmth that can be asked for and given without a price.

champions.name: Clinging Child
champions.role: hold the root-bridge so hard it cannot pulse
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a small child gripping a glowing root-bridge with both arms, knuckles white, refusing to let it move
champions.purpose: The Clinging Child holds the root-bridge so tight it cannot pulse. They are here so holding on can loosen into being held.

champions.name: Lone Wolf
champions.role: circle the islands and never step onto a bridge
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a grey wolf-cloaked figure pacing the dark shore of the farthest island, watching the hearth-light across the water
champions.purpose: The Lone Wolf circles the islands and never steps onto a bridge. He is here so warmth can be asked for once without it feeling like surrender.

champions.name: Watchful Guardian
champions.role: guard the bridge so hard no one can cross it
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a tall guardian in lantern-lit mail standing at the foot of a root-bridge, spear planted, watching every approach
champions.purpose: The Watchful Guardian guards the bridge so hard that no one can cross it, not even those who are welcome. They are here so watching can turn into letting in.

champions.name: The Chameleon
champions.role: become whatever keeps the bridge from snapping
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a figure whose cloak shifts to match each island's colors as they cross from shore to shore
champions.purpose: The Chameleon becomes whatever keeps the bridge from snapping. They are here so a bond can survive them being fully themselves on it.

champions.name: Storm Lover
champions.role: tear the bridge down and rebuild it every night
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a wind-whipped figure standing on a root-bridge that snaps and regrows around their feet, lightning behind them
champions.purpose: The Storm Lover snaps the bridge and regrows it every night and calls that love. They are here so a rupture can be repaired instead of repeated.

champions.name: Silent Oracle
champions.role: know exactly what she needs and never say it aloud
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a still figure in deep blue by the hearth's edge, lips closed, eyes that plainly know what they want
champions.purpose: The Silent Oracle knows exactly what she needs and never says it aloud. She is here so the request can be spoken at the First Hearth.

champions.name: Iron Knight
champions.role: sit by the fire in full armor
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a knight in unyielding iron plate sitting bolt upright beside the First Hearth, visor down, warmth not reaching the metal
champions.purpose: The Iron Knight sits right beside the fire in full armor and stays cold. He is here so one plate can come off near the hearth.

champions.name: Abandoned Prince
champions.role: wait at the end of a bridge that snapped long ago
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a young prince in faded finery sitting at the broken end of a root-bridge, staring across the gap at a lit shore
champions.purpose: The Abandoned Prince still waits at the broken end of a bridge that snapped long ago. He is here so hurt can be said aloud without it being the last word.

champions.name: Nest Builder
champions.role: make a home warm enough to leave and return to
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a figure weaving warm reeds and root-fibre into a wide nest by the hearth, leaving the door side open
champions.purpose: The Nest Builder makes a home warm enough to leave and come back to. They are here to show that asking for space does not put the fire out.

champions.name: Tidewalker
champions.role: come close on the tide and leave on it
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a barefoot wanderer walking the shallows between two islands, footprints filling with water behind them
champions.purpose: The Tidewalker comes close on the tide and leaves on it, never quite stepping onto an island. They are here so staying can be tried for one evening.

champions.name: Bondsmith
champions.role: mend a torn bridge stronger than before
champions.visual_prompt_fragment: a steady smith kneeling at a torn root-bridge, binding the break with glowing fibre until it pulses brighter than the rest
champions.purpose: The Bondsmith mends a torn bridge until it pulses brighter than before. He is here to show what repair after a rupture actually looks like.
